messages:
Noah: Quick ask — need a compact email hero + tiny animated sparkline GIF for the micro-benchmark blast. Goal: show latency vs cost tradeoff in one glance. Target send: next Wed (4 days). Can design take?
Lena: Yep, can do. Can you confirm final messaging + CTA? and do we need 2 variants (sales vs dev personas)?
Noah: Two variants please. Sales: 'Reduce inference cost by 3x'. Dev: 'Predictable 99ms p95 on standard prompts'. CTA: 'See the benchmark'.
Omar: Heads-up on engineering constraints: GIF needs to be <= 200KB for email. Suggest we do a 3-frame micro-sparkline (desktop 600x200, mobile 320x160) and provide a static PNG fallback.
Sam: Copy notes: keep headlines to 6 words. Alt text: 'Sparkline showing cost dropping as latency improves'. Also we should test subject line A/B with emojis.
Lena: Design approach: 1) Hero with compact chart chip + microcopy. 2) tiny animated sparkline (3 frames) and 3) plain PNG fallback. Color palette limited to brand-safe blues + dark charcoal for contrast. Accessibility check for 4.5:1 contrast.
Noah: Perfect. Can you drop a quick mock in Figma by EOD tomorrow? Share export specs too.
Lena: Will do. Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/micro-bench-email-heroes — I'll add frames named "sales_desktop", "sales_mobile", "dev_desktop", "dev_mobile".
Maya: Reminder — marketing ops needs final assets by Tue 10am PST to QA in email platform. Also include tracking params for the CTA: utm_source=email&utm_campaign=microbench_launch
Omar: For GIF export I'm going to try ffmpeg with a palette to save size. Quick command I use: ```ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf palettegen palette.png && ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -i palette.png -lavfi paletteuse output.gif``` Should keep colors tight and filesize low.
Lena: Nice — I'll export frames at 2x and hand off an optimized mp4 + gif + PNGs. Can someone confirm exact CTA button color (hex)?
Noah: Use primary CTA: #0066FF. Secondaries: #111827. Make sure hover state + focus ring included in assets spec.
Sam: Also propose short microcopy variants for testing: 1) 'See the benchmark' 2) 'Check latency & cost' 3) 'View results' — keep under 20 chars.
Lena: Noted. I'll do 3 text treatments and label exports with variant tags.
Maya: I'll add the tracking and the dynamic content tokens for personalization. Once assets are in, I'll run a quick Litmus check for Gmail/Outlook.
FigmaBot: Converted 4 frames to PNG at 600x200 and 320x160. Files uploaded to Figma: /exports/microbench-email-heroes/ (preview links in file).
Omar: One more thought — include an SVG tiny inline fallback for the sparkline for clients that disable images. I can hand off a minimal inline SVG and a plain CSS snippet.
Lena: Good call. I'll include a monochrome SVG + alt copy.
Noah: Thanks team. Summary: Lena to Figma EOD tomorrow, Omar to provide optimized GIF + SVG, Sam final copy variants, Maya to handle tracking & QA. Ping me when exports are uploaded. :rocket:
Maya: Noted — will follow up Tue morning if anything's missing. :thumbsup:
